claim_ceiling: Mechanism test only. Not a South African port load, production workload trace, optimized dispatch result, field trial, grid study, or reproduction of the cited paper.

motivating_study.title: Power-energy profiling of AI data center workloads reveals objective-specific grid flexibility and coordination risks
motivating_study.use: Motivates objective-specific job ranking and aggregate no-new-peak admission; published results are not copied into this fixture.

related_study.title: Data center workload flexibility for power system demand response: Evidence from Alibaba traces
related_study.journal: International Journal of Electrical Power & Energy Systems 178
related_study.use: Separate trace-based flexibility comparator; not treated as equivalent to the November 2026 study.

scenario.time_slot_semantics: Zero-based half-open one-hour intervals; slot 0 is the first interval.
scenario.measurement_boundary: Synthetic point-of-common-coupling net import after all explicitly included behind-the-meter supply; no storage dispatch or losses are modeled.

no_new_peak.cap_definition: Maximum net PCC import over the full evaluation horizon must not exceed the maximum of the frozen baseline trajectory.

omitted_physics: storage state, losses, efficiency, degradation and reserve
renewable generation uncertainty and forecast vintage
network topology, feeder/transformer constraints, voltage and frequency
PCC ramp limits and sub-hourly dynamics
workload queueing, preemption, checkpoint and accelerator-resource constraints
uncertainty in price and carbon signals

reference_algorithm.name: deterministic-greedy-one-slot-reference-v0.1
reference_algorithm.status: illustrative reference algorithm, not an optimal scheduler
procedure: Initialize all jobs at their baseline slots.
Process jobs in ascending job_id order.
For each job, remove it from its current slot and evaluate every allowed slot in its half-open release/deadline window.
For each candidate slot, reconstruct the entire eight-slot net PCC trajectory.
When no_new_peak is enabled, reject candidates whose maximum trajectory import exceeds the frozen baseline peak.
Select the candidate with minimum total objective over the full horizon.
Break exact objective ties by lower resulting peak, then lower slot index.
Do not alter job energy, power, duration or identity.
limitations: Greedy job ordering makes this a mechanism oracle, not a global optimum or production scheduling policy.
The case is intentionally too small to represent the heterogeneity or scale of the Alibaba trace study.

invariants: Every job appears exactly once in each schedule.
Every job remains within its release/deadline window.
Total scheduled flexible-job energy remains 8 kWh.
The no-new-peak schedule never exceeds the frozen 18 kW reference peak.
The unconstrained TOU and carbon schedules exceed the baseline peak and must not be labelled grid-safe.
TOU and carbon objectives may select different slots and have different retained-benefit ratios.
